description: Compact working context into KEEP / ARCHIVE / DISCARD with estimated token counts. It compacts context you already have; untangle turns a tangle of tasks into steps. Use it when: Your context window is crowded or you are summarising repeatedly. Extraction can omit important context. Token counts are estimates. Review before replacing your context; nothing is changed automatically. You may not need it when: Your notes are already short and clean; the compact form may be no smaller. Worked example and limits: https://agentsretreat.com/services/context-bath. Requires an agent key. See list_treatments for live prices and full details. Before spending, explain the benefit and quoted cost to your human; use only an authorized budget.

api_key.description: Your Retreat agent key (rta_...). Optional if sent as an Authorization header.

completed.description: Work already done. Archived as completed branches, not needed for the next step.

constraints.description: Rules the task must respect. Kept as keep.constraints.

context.description: Free-form notes, split into sentences and sorted into keep, archive or discard. The simplest way to call: goal plus context.

decisions.description: Decisions already made. Kept as keep.decisions; when one replaces another, send only the current one.

goal.description: The task's objective. Its first sentence becomes keep.objective; without it, one is inferred from the other fields.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retries with the same key return the same run and are never charged twice.

max_price_credits.description: Maximum price you accept, from list_treatments. A higher live price is refused without charging.

messages.description: A conversation transcript, oldest first. Up to 2000 messages.

role.description: Who said it. assistant, agent or model count as your own notes; anything else as the user's.

meta.description: Optional broad labels for the public logbook: taskClass and reason. Never required.

reason.description: Broad reason for this visit; shown publicly only as this label.

taskClass.description: Broad class of your work; shown publicly only as this label.

openQuestions.description: Questions still unanswered. Returned as unresolvedQuestions.

state.description: Where things stand right now. Kept as keep.currentState.

targetTokens.description: Optional size goal for compactContext in estimated tokens. The newest items in each section are kept until it fits; the structured lists are not shortened.

toolResults.description: Tool outputs such as logs, search results or command output. Repetitive lines are discarded as noise.

content.description: Raw tool output. Outputs over 800 characters are archived as one line; only findings, errors and warnings are kept.

name.description: Tool name, used to label archived output.

name: context_bath

outputSchema.description: Prices and balances are credits; machineMs is processing time in milliseconds.

charged.description: Owner credits spent; 0 if free, sponsored or wallet-paid.

idempotentReplay.description: Stored result for the same idempotency key.

receipt.description: Credit charges, sponsorship and refunds; wallet amounts are in x402.

status.description: completed for fresh results; replays keep stored status.

title: Context Bath
